rows.reason: GetGun pushes the Lua object of the index-th gun device under the unit; the host's gun rows have no Lua entity tables to push

ForceEnableInput edits the game+5B0h suppression set; that set is GameMissionFrameHost's InputTickState, whose action records the host never fills (live input runs on game_input_runtime's native records), so the reset 004E4E6C applies would change nothing
GetAirBaseStatus pushes 006BF5C0, which reads block+9Ch and the +4 tracked lock; AirOpsDeck models neither (its 006BF5C0 body takes a raw block)
GetAirBaseSlotStatus reads slot+2Ch through pointer arithmetic on [block+4Ch] (58h stride); it needs an ImageAccess view that maps the deck's slot vector onto that address space, not built
SquadronSetHomeBase calls 007F1C00 mid-mission; the units host has no live squadron home-base field (set_squadron_scene_home_base only stages pass C's HomeBase key)
SetGuiName calls entity vtable+0Ch with the display name; the units/HUD hosts keep no per-unit GUI name for it to set

GetShipSpeed needs the vtable+38h speed dispatch (ship 0092D730, plane 007B8E60, squadron 007ED470), which lives file-local in game_hosts_lua.cpp next to GetEntitySpeed (leased by g5-w5); route it there with a Seg56HostUnreached adapter
GetDamagedGFXLevel reads unit+358h; the gunnery host keeps it only as a private vector written by SetDamagedGFXLevel, not by the damage-state raises (00877B00), and exposes no getter
GetFormationShape reads group+500h; the units host's FormationGroup stores no shape index (reshape_formation_0070efd0 applies it and keeps nothing)

IsPlayerControlled needs a Left55Seg56aHost adapter base and 00779B60 reads raw unit+1ACh, game+1FE4h and [[00E198C4]+54h]+5 (the map screen's applied byte, only inside GameHudHost); no typed view of those exists
ActivateSpawnpoint's one-argument arm calls 0084CE60 on a SpawnPoint support site; the scene contents pass instantiates no SpawnPoint, so there is no site object
DeactivateSpawnpoint: as ActivateSpawnpoint, no SpawnPoint support-site object in this host
SetNumbering calls 008761E0, which stores unit+35Ch and sets the model's hull numbering; the units host has no numbering field and no model instance (+360h)

The gamecamera / fpscamera movie modifier needs a modifier slot beside goaround in MovieKeyframe and 0079CBD0's game cameras; only the ShipCaptain mover exists (no plane chase or cockpit camera), and how 00795650 consumes the modifier's world pose was not traced
The keyframe-event SetEntity bodies register an entity observer (00694A60 / 006952A0); the host has no entity deletion or observer registry, so a `noentity` event could never fire

The BotTask_Make* factories (009AB570, 009B9030, 009BADB0, 009C8C70, 009CA2B0, 009CD300, 009D4E30, 009A6970) build native bot task objects; the host's create_bot_task hands out an index and no BotTask objects exist
group_forward_command needs an AI group at entity+16Ch; its only producer is AICreateGroup (00A38A50), which no installed mission script calls, so entity_ai_group answers null
